searchText: I found an issue in lodestar's sha256`digest()` function I notice the only client that sometimes has the same `message-id` to lodestar is grandine so maybe an issue there, if you want to double there cc <@498331483732312075> (but sometimes the same grandine node returned the same `message-id` to other clients so it's confusing ..) Hi. I'm trying to setup a beacon rpc with lodestar. Here's my command ```bash sudo docker run -d --network=host --restart=no \ -v "/home/muhitrhn/jwt.hex:/jwt.hex" \ -v "/home/muhitrhn/.lodestar:/data" \ "chainsafe/lodestar:latest" \ beacon \ --network=sepolia \ --dataDir=/data \ --jwtSecret=/jwt.hex \ --listenAddress=0.0.0.0 \ --port=9000 \ --discoveryPort=9000 \ --checkpointSyncUrl=https://lodestar-sepolia.chainsafe.io \ --enr.ip="34.71.222.126" \ --enr.tcp=9000 \ --rest \ --rest.address=0.0.0.0 \ --rest.port=4000 \ --rest.namespace="*" \ --execution.urls=https://ethereum-sepolia-rpc.publicnode.com \ --targetPeers=160 \ --discv5=true \ --logLevel=debug \ --logFile=/data/lodestar.log \ --logFileLevel=debug``` I'm getting errors in the attachment. Any help please? incorrect message-id from digest() Hey there, the better place to address this is the Chainsafe discord. Seems like EL connection issue. Locally 48/72 blobs network finalizes without lots of orphaned, teku as cl. One accepted 72 blobs block was proposed by reth. On average it's like 25 blobs. It was finalizing even with 6sec slot, but had lots of orhpans, like 50% Hm in case of a small network, there is 1 hop. But what if we make a circle from nodes so they see just two neighbors? Can help to test more real case in a small network ig Peerdas-devnet-7 is going down tonight. All future testing should be moved to fusaka devnet 0

excerpts.author: tuyen4818
excerpts.content:
I found an issue in lodestar's  sha256`digest()` function
I notice the only client that sometimes has the same `message-id` to lodestar is grandine so maybe an issue there, if you want to double there cc <@498331483732312075> 
(but sometimes the same grandine node returned the same `message-id` to other clients so it's confusing ..)

excerpts.author: stealth.gecko
excerpts.content:
Hi. I'm trying to setup a beacon rpc with lodestar. Here's my command ```bash
sudo docker run -d --network=host --restart=no \
    -v "/home/muhitrhn/jwt.hex:/jwt.hex" \
    -v "/home/muhitrhn/.lodestar:/data" \
    "chainsafe/lodestar:latest" \
    beacon \
    --network=sepolia \
    --dataDir=/data \
    --jwtSecret=/jwt.hex \
    --listenAddress=0.0.0.0 \
    --port=9000 \
    --discoveryPort=9000 \
    --checkpointSyncUrl=https://lodestar-sepolia.chainsafe.io \
    --enr.ip="34.71.222.126" \
    --enr.tcp=9000 \
    --rest \
    --rest.address=0.0.0.0 \
    --rest.port=4000 \
    --rest.namespace="*" \
    --execution.urls=https://ethereum-sepolia-rpc.publicnode.com \
    --targetPeers=160 \
    --discv5=true \
    --logLevel=debug \
    --logFile=/data/lodestar.log \
    --logFileLevel=debug```
I'm getting errors in the attachment. Any help please?
